definition_en: to help or hold something up, or to provide for someone
core_image: 两根柱子稳稳托住屋顶
scene: 家人支持她的决定。Her family supported her decision.
sceneCN: 这里 support 是「支持」（第 1 个义项）；句意：家人支持她的决定。

senses.title: To back someone
senses.definition: to help someone or agree with a plan
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人或赞成某个计划
senses.example: Her family supported her decision.
senses.exampleCN: 家人支持她的决定。
senses.why: This is the main social sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是主要的社会关系义项。

senses.title: To hold up
senses.definition: to carry the weight of something
senses.definitionCN: 承受某物的重量
senses.example: The columns support the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 这些柱子支撑着屋顶。
senses.why: This is the physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理义项。

senses.title: Help or a prop
senses.definition: help given, or a thing that holds something up
senses.definitionCN: 给予的帮助，或托住某物的东西
senses.example: The bridge needs more support.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥需要更多支撑。
senses.why: This noun covers help and structure.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词涵盖帮助与支撑结构。

senses.title: To provide for
senses.definition: to pay for the needs of someone
senses.definitionCN: 负担某人的生活需要
senses.example: He supports a family of four.
senses.exampleCN: 他供养四口之家。
senses.why: Here support means money and care.
senses.whyCN: 这里指金钱与生活照料。

definition_en: to think that something is probably true, or to imagine it for an argument
core_image: 一个人闭上眼，据桌上的线索猜测答案
scene: 我猜他已经在路上了。I suppose he is already on his way.
sceneCN: 这里 suppose 是「猜想」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我猜他已经在路上了。

senses.title: To think probably
senses.definition: to think something is probably true
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事很可能是真的
senses.example: I suppose he is already on his way.
senses.exampleCN: 我猜他已经在路上了。
senses.why: This is the everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常义项。

senses.title: To imagine for argument
senses.definition: to imagine something as a starting point
senses.definitionCN: 把某事当作推理的起点
senses.example: Suppose you had one more day.
senses.exampleCN: 假设你再多一天时间。
senses.why: Here the word sets up a condition.
senses.whyCN: 这里是在设定条件。

senses.title: To be expected to
senses.definition: to be expected or required to do something
senses.definitionCN: 被期望或被要求做某事
senses.example: You are supposed to sign here.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该在这里签名。
senses.why: This is the fixed be supposed to pattern.
senses.whyCN: 这是 be supposed to 的固定用法。

intro.cn: suppose 来自拉丁语 supponere，意为放在下面。

items.en: Suppose meant to think or assume.

note.en: Suppose is compared with look-alike words and with verbs of assuming.
note.cn: 把 suppose 与形近词以及表示假定的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to take as true without proof
to form a picture in the mind

normalIntro.en: To suppose is to place an idea under a question and see if it holds.

definition_en: certain that something is true or will happen
core_image: 一个人点头，把手放在心口表示确定
scene: 我确信自己锁了门。I am sure that I locked the door.
sceneCN: 这里 sure 是「确信的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我确信自己锁了门。

senses.title: Certain in your mind
senses.definition: feeling no doubt about something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事没有怀疑
senses.example: I am sure that I locked the door.
senses.exampleCN: 我确信自己锁了门。
senses.why: This sense describes a person's confidence.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项描述人的把握。

senses.title: Certain to happen
senses.definition: certain to happen or be true
senses.definitionCN: 注定会发生或确实如此
senses.example: It is sure to rain tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 今晚一定会下雨。
senses.why: Here the word describes the event.
senses.whyCN: 这里描述的是事情本身。

senses.title: Certainly, in speech
senses.definition: used in speech to mean certainly
senses.definitionCN: 口语中表示当然
senses.example: Sure, I can help you.
senses.exampleCN: 当然，我可以帮你。
senses.why: This is the short spoken reply.
senses.whyCN: 这是简短的口语回应。

definition_en: a study of opinions or facts, or to look over an area
core_image: 研究员拿着问卷站在街角，记录路人的回答
scene: 研究者调查了五百名居民。The researchers surveyed five hundred residents.
sceneCN: 这里 survey 是「调查」（第 1 个义项）；句意：研究者调查了五百名居民。

senses.title: A study of opinions
senses.definition: a set of questions used to collect opinions or facts
senses.definitionCN: 用于收集意见或事实的一组问题
senses.example: The researchers surveyed five hundred residents.
senses.exampleCN: 研究者调查了五百名居民。
senses.why: This is the common social-science sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是常见的社会科学义项。

senses.title: The measuring of land
senses.definition: the act of measuring land or an area

senses.example: They surveyed the land before building.

senses.why: This is the older technical sense.

senses.title: A general view
senses.definition: a broad look at a whole subject
senses.definitionCN: 对整体主题的总体观察
senses.example: The book gives a survey of modern art.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书对现代艺术作了概览。
senses.why: Here the word means looking over the whole.
senses.whyCN: 这里指通览整体。

abstract.en: A survey is a way of seeing a whole without touching every part.

abstract.en: The word once meant to look down from above.

abstract.en: To survey is to turn scattered facts into a shape.

definition_en: the state of continuing to live or exist
core_image: 荒岛上的一顶小帐篷，旁边还燃着一小堆火
scene: 在寒冷的海水中，生存需要极大的勇气。Survival in the cold sea required great courage.
sceneCN: 这里 survival 是「幸存」（第 1 个义项）；句意：在寒冷的海水中，生存需要极大的勇气。

senses.title: Continuing to live
senses.definition: the state of continuing to live through danger
senses.definitionCN: 经历危险后继续存活的状态
senses.example: Survival in the cold sea required great courage.
senses.exampleCN: 在寒冷的海水中，生存需要极大的勇气。
senses.why: This is the core sense of staying alive.
senses.whyCN: 这是「活下来」的核心义项。

senses.title: Something that has lasted
senses.definition: a custom or object that has continued from an earlier time
senses.definitionCN: 从更早时期留存下来的习俗或物品
senses.example: The old song is a survival from an earlier age.
senses.exampleCN: 这首老歌是更早时代的遗存。
senses.why: Here the word names what time has left behind.
senses.whyCN: 这里指时间留下的东西。

intro.en: Survival is the noun built on survive, meaning to outlive.
intro.cn: survival 是建立在 survive（活得更久）之上的名词。

items.en: Survival named the state of lasting through danger.
items.cn: survival 指经历危险而存续的状态。

note.en: Survival is compared with look-alike words and with words for staying alive.
note.cn: 把 survival 与形近词以及表示存活的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Survival is life continuing against difficulty.
normalIntro.cn: survival 是生命在困境中继续。

normal.en: Survival in the cold sea required great courage.
normal.cn: 在寒冷的海水中，生存需要极大的勇气。

normal.en: The survival rate of the seedlings was high.
normal.cn: 幼苗的存活率很高。

normal.en: They learned basic survival skills in the forest.
normal.cn: 他们在森林里学习基本生存技能。

normal.en: The struggle for survival shapes every species.
normal.cn: 为生存而挣扎塑造着每个物种。

normal.en: The old song is a survival from an earlier age.
normal.cn: 这首老歌是更早时代的遗存。

abstract.en: Survival is not only staying alive but keeping something alive.
abstract.cn: 生存不只是自己活着，也让某种东西延续。

abstract.en: The word measures how much of the past the present carries.
abstract.cn: 这个词衡量现在承载了多少过去。

abstract.en: Every survival is a small victory of continuation.
abstract.cn: 每一次幸存都是延续的小小胜利。

examples.en: Survival in the cold sea required great courage.
examples.cn: 在寒冷的海水中，生存需要极大的勇气。

core.en: Life lasting through danger and time.
core.cn: 生命穿过危险与时间而延续。

branches.en: Survival in the cold sea required great courage.

branches.en: The old song is a survival from an earlier age.

definition_zh: 幸存；幸免于；存活；比…活得长
definition_en: to continue to live after danger, or to live longer than someone
core_image: 风暴过后，一株小树仍立在断枝之间
scene: 只有少数植物能在沙漠中存活。Only a few plants can survive in the desert.
sceneCN: 这里 survive 是「存活」（第 1 个义项）；句意：只有少数植物能在沙漠中存活。

senses.title: To stay alive
senses.definition: to continue to live, especially in difficult conditions
senses.definitionCN: 尤其在困境中继续活着
senses.example: Only a few plants can survive in the desert.
senses.exampleCN: 只有少数植物能在沙漠中存活。
senses.why: This is the core sense of staying alive.
senses.whyCN: 这是「活下来」的核心义项。

senses.title: To live through danger
senses.definition: to continue to live after an accident or attack
senses.definitionCN: 在事故或攻击之后仍然活着
senses.example: She survived the accident without serious injury.
senses.exampleCN: 她在事故中幸存，没有受重伤。
senses.why: Here the word focuses on passing through danger.
senses.whyCN: 这里强调闯过危险。

senses.title: To outlive someone
senses.definition: to continue to live after another person has died
senses.definitionCN: 在他人去世后仍然活着
senses.example: He survived his wife by ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 他比妻子多活了十年。
senses.why: This sense compares two lives.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项比较两条生命。

intro.en: Survive is built from Latin for living beyond.
intro.cn: survive 由拉丁语中表示「活过」的部分构成。

note.en: Survive is compared with look-alike words and with verbs for lasting.
note.cn: 把 survive 与形近词以及表示持续存在的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Survive means to keep living past danger or another life.
normalIntro.cn: survive 意为活过危险，或活得比他人更久。

normal.en: They survived on berries and rain water.

normal.en: The business survived the hard winter.
normal.cn: 这家企业在艰难的冬天挺了过来。

abstract.en: To survive is to carry life through a test.
abstract.cn: 幸存就是带着生命穿过一场考验。

abstract.en: The word joins living with going beyond.
abstract.cn: 这个词把「活着」与「越过」结合起来。

abstract.en: What survives is not unchanged; it is what could bend.
abstract.cn: 幸存下来的并非一成不变，而是能弯曲的东西。

definition_en: to believe someone may be guilty, or a person thought to be guilty
core_image: 警探在灯下翻看档案，目光停在一个人名上
scene: 警方怀疑他把钱藏了起来。The police suspect that he hid the money.
sceneCN: 这里 suspect 是「怀疑」（第 1 个义项）；句意：警方怀疑他把钱藏了起来。

senses.title: To believe someone is guilty
senses.definition: to think that someone may be guilty or dishonest
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人可能有罪或不诚实
senses.example: The police suspect that he hid the money.
senses.exampleCN: 警方怀疑他把钱藏了起来。
senses.why: This is the core sense of suspicion.
senses.whyCN: 这是「怀疑」的核心义项。

senses.title: A person believed guilty
senses.definition: a person believed to have committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 被认为犯了罪的人
senses.example: The suspect was held for questioning.
senses.exampleCN: 嫌疑犯被拘留审问。
senses.why: As a noun the word names the person.
senses.whyCN: 作名词时指人。

senses.title: Likely to be bad or false
senses.definition: likely to be bad, false, or dangerous
senses.definitionCN: 可能是坏的、假的或危险的
senses.example: They found a suspect package by the door.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在门边发现一个可疑包裹。
senses.why: As an adjective it describes things that raise doubt.
senses.whyCN: 作形容词时描述引起怀疑的事物。

intro.cn: suspect 来自一个意为「仰视并起疑」的拉丁语动词。

items.en: Suspect became a verb and a noun.

note.en: Suspect is compared with look-alike words and with words for doubt.
note.cn: 把 suspect 与形近词以及表示怀疑的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Suspect links the act of doubting and the person doubted.

normal.en: The suspect was held for questioning.

normal.en: They found a suspect package by the door.

normal.en: I suspect the plan will fail.

normal.en: She was suspected of taking the file.

abstract.en: To suspect is to look at someone and see a hidden possibility.
abstract.cn: 怀疑就是看着某人并看见一种隐藏的可能。

abstract.en: The word moves easily from a feeling to a person to a thing.
abstract.cn: 这个词轻易地从感觉转到人，再转到物。

abstract.en: Doubt can protect us, yet it can also wound the innocent.
abstract.cn: 怀疑能保护我们，也能伤害无辜者。

core.en: Seeing a hidden possibility in someone.

branches.en: The police suspect that he hid the money.

branches.en: I suspect the plan will fail.

branches.en: They found a suspect package by the door.

definition_en: a feeling that someone may be guilty or something may be wrong

senses.title: A feeling of doubt

senses.example: His explanation aroused the teacher's suspicion.
senses.exampleCN: 他的解释引起了老师的怀疑。
senses.why: This is the core feeling sense.

senses.title: A very small amount

senses.definitionCN: 极少的一点

intro.en: Suspicion is the noun form of the Latin verb for mistrusting.
intro.cn: suspicion 是拉丁语「怀疑」动词的名词形式。

items.en: Suspicion meant a feeling of doubt.

items.cn: suspicion 也表示极少的一点。

note.en: Suspicion is compared with look-alike words and with words for doubt.

normalIntro.en: Suspicion is doubt with a direction: toward a person or a story.
normalIntro.cn: suspicion 是有方向的怀疑：指向某个人或某个说法。

normal.cn: 他的解释引起了老师的怀疑。

normal.cn: 那个人受到怀疑达数周之久。

normal.en: There was a suspicion of a smile on her face.
normal.cn: 她脸上有一丝笑意。

normal.en: The evidence cast suspicion on the guard.
normal.cn: 证据把怀疑指向了守卫。

abstract.en: It protects and it isolates at the same time.

definition_zh: 交换；互换；用…替换；把…换掉
definition_en: to give something to someone and receive something in return, or to replace one thing with another
core_image: 两只手同时递出和接回：东西在掌心之间换了个位置
scene: 午休时，小丽不想吃自己盒饭里的鸡腿，隔壁的同学正好爱吃鸡腿。They agreed to swap the chicken leg for a piece of chocolate cake.
sceneCN: 这里 swap 是「交换、互换」（第 1 个义项：拿一样东西换另一样东西）；句意是他们商量好用鸡腿换一块巧克力蛋糕。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加表示动作者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「交换者」，使用频率较低
复合名词，义为「旧货交换集市」，主要见于美式英语

senses.title: To exchange one thing for another
senses.definition: to give one thing to someone and receive a different thing in return
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西给别人，同时换回另一样东西
senses.example: The kids swapped baseball cards during recess.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在课间交换棒球卡。
senses.why: The core image of two hands passing things in opposite directions naturally gives the basic meaning of exchanging items.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是两只手朝相反方向递东西，最自然地长出「拿物换物」这一基本义。

senses.title: To replace one thing with another
senses.definition: to take one thing out of a place or role and put a different thing there instead
senses.definitionCN: 把一样东西从某个位置或用途中拿走，换成另一样
senses.example: You should swap the flat tire for the spare one.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该把爆胎换上备用胎。
senses.why: Once two things trade positions, the thing left behind has been replaced, extending the sense from mutual exchange to substitution.
senses.whyCN: 两样东西换了位置之后，原来的东西就被换下来了，词义由「互换取物」延伸为「替换」。

senses.title: To exchange information or words
senses.definition: to share news, ideas, or remarks with someone in a back-and-forth way
senses.definitionCN: 以一来一往的方式与某人分享消息、想法或说话
senses.example: The two scientists swapped opinions for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 两位科学家交流观点聊了几个小时。
senses.why: Conversation is itself an exchange: words travel back and forth like the objects in the core image.
senses.whyCN: 交谈本身就是一种往来，话语像核心意象中的物件一样来回传递，于是长出「交流、交谈」的抽象义。

senses.title: To trade shifts, roles, or duties
senses.definition: to agree with someone that each of you will do the other's shift, role, or task
senses.definitionCN: 与对方约定各自接替对方的班次、角色或任务
senses.example: Can I swap shifts with you next Friday?
senses.exampleCN: 下周五我能和你换个班吗？
senses.why: A duty can be handed over just like a physical object, so the exchange image applies to jobs and roles.
senses.whyCN: 职责可以像实物一样被交到另一个人手里，交换的意象便套用在班次与角色上。

senses.title: An act of exchanging things
senses.definition: an occasion when two people or groups exchange things
senses.definitionCN: 双方互相交换东西的一次行为或场合
senses.example: The deal was a swap of oil for grain.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔交易是用石油换粮食。
senses.why: A repeated action becomes a noun: the whole event of two hands passing things gets named.
senses.whyCN: 动作反复发生便被命名，两手互递东西的整个事件凝固为名词「一次交换」。

senses.title: A thing that has been exchanged
senses.definition: the item received in an exchange, especially in children's games or collections
senses.definitionCN: 在交换中拿到的东西，多见于儿童游戏或收藏活动
senses.example: She showed me her swaps from the sticker fair.
senses.exampleCN: 她给我看她从贴纸集市换来的宝贝。
senses.why: The result of the exchange, not the act itself, becomes the thing talked about, a regular noun shift.
senses.whyCN: 被谈论的对象从「交换这件事」转到「换回来的结果」，是名词义从动作到结果的常规转移。

senses.title: To change one choice or plan for another
senses.definition: to decide to use or do something different from what was first planned or chosen
senses.definitionCN: 决定改用或改做与最初计划、选择不同的事
senses.example: We swapped the indoor picnic for a restaurant dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 我们放弃了室内野餐，改成去餐厅吃饭。
senses.why: Plans sit in the mind like objects in a hand; changing a plan is mentally putting one down and picking up another.
senses.whyCN: 计划像握在手中的东西，改换计划就是把一个放下、把另一个拿起，意象从实物移到抽象决定。

senses.title: To exchange currencies or financial instruments
senses.definition: in finance, to exchange one stream of payments, currency, or interest rates for another under an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 在金融领域，按协议把一种现金流、货币或利率换成另一种
senses.example: The two banks signed a currency swap agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 两家银行签署了货币互换协议。
senses.why: Finance borrows the everyday exchange image and fixes it as a technical term for exchanging streams of money.
senses.whyCN: 金融借用了日常交换的画面，把「互换来去」固定为交换资金流的术语。

senses.title: To swap over or swap round
senses.definition: to make two things trade places so that each occupies the other's former position
senses.definitionCN: 让两样东西互换位置，各自占据对方原来的地方
senses.example: The teacher swapped the two desks round to make more space.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把两张课桌对调位置，好腾出更多空间。
senses.why: The phrase emphasizes the result of the exchange: the two items have literally traded positions.
senses.whyCN: 短语强调交换的结果：两样东西确实互换了位置，是「交换」义向空间格局的落实。

intro.en: Swap is a native English word whose earlier history is uncertain; it belongs to a small family of verbs describing hitting or moving back and forth, and its modern sense of exchanging appears to have developed from the idea of two things striking or crossing.
intro.cn: swap 是英语本土词，更早的来历不确定；它属于一小族描写击打或来回摆动的动词，现代「交换」义一般认为是由「两物相击、来去交错」的画面发展而来。

items.en: The verb swappen appears, meaning to strike or to move with a swinging or sweeping motion.
items.cn: 中世纪英语出现动词 swappen，意为击打，或以摆动、挥动的方式移动。

items.en: The extended senses 'to dash' and 'to strike down' are recorded; the word also begins to describe back-and-forth motion.
items.cn: 十六世纪记录了「猛冲、击倒」等引申义；这个词也开始描写一来一往的动作。

items.en: The exchange sense develops, first in informal use; some older dictionaries long treated it as slang, a sign of its colloquial origin.
items.cn: 「交换」义发展出来，最初见于口语；旧词典长期把它标为俚语，可见其口头来源。

items.en: The noun use (an act of exchange) becomes established, and the word spreads from speech into general written use.
items.cn: 名词用法（一次交换）确立下来，这个词从口语进入一般书面语。

items.en: Swap extends to information, duties, plans, and finance (currency swaps, interest rate swaps), while older strike senses survive only in dialects.
items.cn: swap 延伸到信息、班次、计划和金融领域（货币互换、利率掉期）；旧的「击打」义只残留在方言里。

items.en: The deeper origin is uncertain. Swap may be imitative of a swishing or striking sound; a link to the verb swerve or to low German words of similar meaning is sometimes suggested but not proven.
items.cn: 更深的来源不确定。一般认为 swap 可能是模拟挥击声的拟声词；有学者把它与 swerve 或低地德语中意义相近的词相联系，但均无确证。

note.en: Words that look or sound like swap, and words that live nearby in the field of exchanging.
note.cn: 与 swap 拼写或发音相近的词，以及与「交换」义场相邻的词。

entries.definition: an area of soft, wet land; to flood or overwhelm
entries.definitionCN: 沼泽；淹没，使应接不暇。只是比 swap 多一个字母 p，词义完全不同，属拼写相近但词源无关

entries.definition: to move slowly from side to side; to influence someone

entries.definition: to give and receive things in return; the act of doing so
entries.definitionCN: 交换；兑换。较正式，涵盖 swap 的核心义，常用于货币、书信、礼品等场景

entries.definition: to buy, sell, or exchange goods or services

entries.definition: to exchange goods without using money

entries.definition: to exchange things or ideas with each other

normalIntro.en: Five grounded hooks that tie swap to its spelling, sound, and real-life uses.
normalIntro.cn: 五条接地气的联想，把 swap 和它的拼写、读音与生活用法绑在一起。

normal.en: swap sounds like 'swuap' — think of hands crossing in the air as two people hand things over at the same moment.
normal.cn: swap 读起来像「斯握铺」——想象两个人同时递东西，两只手在空中交叉而过。

normal.en: SW-A-P: Students Will Always Pass things around — that passing is swapping.
normal.cn: S-W-A-P 可记为「Students Will Always Pass」——学生总在传东西，传着传着就是交换。

normal.en: swap and swamp differ by one letter: you swap cards, but you get swamped with homework.
normal.cn: swap 与 swamp 只差一个字母：换卡片用 swap，作业多到「被淹」（应接不暇）用 swamp。

normal.en: In finance you will meet currency swap — banks literally handing money streams back and forth.
normal.cn: 金融里会遇到 currency swap（货币互换）——银行把两股资金流你来我往地递来递去。

normal.en: swap meet is a market where everything is obtained by swapping, not buying.
normal.cn: swap meet 是「以物换物的集市」，一切靠交换而非购买。

abstract.en: Picture a revolving door: two people enter from opposite sides and exit with each other's place.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇旋转门：两人从相对的门进，出来时彼此站到了对方原来的位置。

abstract.en: Picture two dancers changing partners in mid-song without missing a beat.
abstract.cn: 想象两位舞者在乐曲中途互换舞伴，节奏丝毫不乱。

abstract.en: Picture two cups on a table being slid across each other's tracks until they sit where the other stood.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上两只杯子被推着划过对方的轨迹，最后各坐在对方原来的位置上。

examples.en: The two neighbours swap vegetables from their gardens every week.
examples.cn: 两位邻居每周互换自家菜园里的蔬菜。

examples.en: He swapped his old laptop for a second-hand bike.
examples.cn: 他用自己的旧笔记本电脑换了一辆二手自行车。

examples.en: The students swapped email addresses before the summer break.
examples.cn: 学生们在暑假前互留了电子邮箱。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「斯握铺」——两人各自握着东西，摊开手掌互铺到对方掌中，东西就换过去了。

root: swap 是英语本土词，无拉丁词根可依。一般认为与中世纪英语 swappen（挥击、摆动）同源，可能属拟声词；其「交换」义由「一来一往的动作」引申而来，深层来源不确定，不作强行构词解释。

sensesIntro.en: From physically exchanging objects, swap spreads to replacing things, trading words, duties, plans, and finally streams of money in finance.
sensesIntro.cn: swap 从实物的互换出发，扩展到替换物品、交流话语、对调班次、改换计划，最后落到金融资金的互换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands passing in opposite directions, each leaving something behind and taking something away
core.cn: 核心意象：两只手朝相反方向递来递去，各自放下一样、带走一样

branches.en: the basic trade of physical objects
branches.cn: 实物对换：卡片、蔬菜、礼物

branches.en: what one side keeps gets replaced or the plan changes
branches.cn: 换位带来的替换与改换：换轮胎、改计划

branches.en: words and ideas moving back and forth
branches.cn: 话语的往来：交流观点、聊天

branches.en: positions and duties literally trading places
branches.cn: 班次与位置的对调：换班、对调课桌

branches.en: the act, its result, and the formal financial extension
branches.cn: 名词化与术语化：一笔交易、换来的东西、金融互换

intro.en: Swap has no classical prefix or suffix, but its family, derivatives, and fixed phrases show how a native monosyllable builds new uses.
intro.cn: swap 没有古典前缀或后缀，但它的词族、派生词与固定搭配展示了本土单音节词如何长出新用法。

latinIntro.en: Swap is not of Latin origin, so this section instead lists fixed phrases and near relatives that are often confused with it.
latinIntro.cn: swap 并非源自拉丁语，这里列出常与之混淆的固定搭配和近亲词。

definition_en: to make a serious promise, or to use rude words
core_image: 证人举起手，在法庭上郑重承诺
scene: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。He swore to tell the truth in court.
sceneCN: 这里 swear 是「发誓」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他在法庭上发誓说出真相。

senses.title: To make a serious promise
senses.definition: to promise seriously that something is true
senses.definitionCN: 郑重承诺某事为真
senses.example: He swore to tell the truth in court.
senses.exampleCN: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。
senses.why: This is the core sense of a solemn promise.
senses.whyCN: 这是郑重承诺的核心义项。

senses.title: To take a formal oath
senses.definition: to make a formal promise in a legal or public setting
senses.definitionCN: 在法律或公开场合正式承诺
senses.example: The witness swore an oath before speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 证人在发言前宣了誓。
senses.why: Here the promise is formal and public.
senses.whyCN: 这里承诺是正式而公开的。

senses.title: To use rude words
senses.definition: to speak angrily with offensive words
senses.definitionCN: 用冒犯性词语愤怒地说话
senses.example: He swore loudly when he dropped the box.
senses.exampleCN: 他摔落箱子时大声咒骂。
senses.why: This sense comes from the force of an oath.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项来自誓言的力量。

intro.en: Swear is an old Germanic word for taking an oath.
intro.cn: swear 是表示宣誓的古老日耳曼词。

items.en: Swaran meant to swear an oath.
Swere kept the sense of a solemn promise.
items.cn: swere 保留了郑重承诺之义。

items.en: Sworn became an adjective for formal oaths.
items.cn: sworn 成为描述正式誓言的形容词。

note.en: Swear is compared with look-alike words and with words for promising.
note.cn: 把 swear 与形近词以及表示承诺的词作比较。

entries.definition: to say one will do something

normalIntro.en: Swear makes a promise that calls the truth as witness.
normalIntro.cn: swear 作出以真相为见证的承诺。

normal.en: He swore to tell the truth in court.
normal.cn: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。

normal.en: The witness swore an oath before speaking.
normal.cn: 证人在发言前宣了誓。

normal.en: He swore loudly when he dropped the box.
normal.cn: 他摔落箱子时大声咒骂。

normal.en: She swore never to return.
normal.cn: 她发誓再也不回来。

normal.en: They were sworn in as new officers.
normal.cn: 他们宣誓就任新官员。

abstract.en: To swear is to tie your words to your honor.
abstract.cn: 发誓就是把言语系在荣誉上。

abstract.en: The same word can bless a promise or break the air with anger.
abstract.cn: 同一个词既能祝福承诺，也能用怒火撕裂空气。

abstract.en: An oath asks time to witness what the mouth says now.
abstract.cn: 誓言请时间来见证此刻口中之言。

examples.en: He swore to tell the truth in court.
examples.cn: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。

examples.en: He swore loudly when he dropped the box.
examples.cn: 他摔落箱子时大声咒骂。

examples.en: She swore never to return.
examples.cn: 她发誓再也不回来。

dict_mnemonic.note: 义项记忆 · 发誓 → 宣誓 → 咒骂
dict_mnemonic.text: swear 本义是郑重起誓，正式场合即「宣誓」，而愤怒时的誓言久而久之变成「咒骂」。

root: 来自古英语 swerian，源于日耳曼语 swaran（宣誓），核心是以言语郑重作保。

sensesIntro.en: Swear means to promise solemnly, to take a formal oath, or to speak rudely.
sensesIntro.cn: swear 指郑重发誓、正式宣誓，或粗鲁咒骂。

core.en: Words bound to honor.

branches.en: He swore to tell the truth in court.
branches.cn: 他在法庭上发誓说出真相。

branches.en: She swore never to return.
branches.cn: 她发誓再也不回来。

branches.en: The witness swore an oath before speaking.
branches.cn: 证人在发言前宣了誓。

branches.en: He swore loudly when he dropped the box.
branches.cn: 他摔落箱子时大声咒骂。

branches.en: A private promise and a public oath share one verb.
branches.cn: 私下承诺与公开宣誓共用一个动词。

intro.en: Swear forms swore, sworn, swearing, and the adjective sworn.
intro.cn: swear 可构成 swore、sworn、swearing 与形容词 sworn。

latinIntro.en: Swear is Germanic; Latin iurare, to swear, survives in jury and jurist.
latinIntro.cn: swear 属于日耳曼语；拉丁语 iurare（宣誓）仍留在 jury 与 jurist 中。

items.example: He swore to tell the truth.

latinEntries.example: Swerian is the Old English source of swear.
latinEntries.exampleCN: swerian 是 swear 的古英语来源。

definition_en: to clean a surface with a brush, or to move quickly and forcefully across an area
core_image: 清晨的店主用长帚把落叶扫到路边
scene: 他每天早上扫门前的落叶。He sweeps the fallen leaves in front of the door every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 sweep 是「打扫」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他每天早上扫门前的落叶。

senses.title: To clean with a brush
senses.definition: to clean a floor or surface with a brush
senses.definitionCN: 用刷帚清洁地面或表面
senses.example: He sweeps the fallen leaves in front of the door every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 他每天早上扫门前的落叶。
senses.why: This is the basic household sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的家务义项。

senses.title: To move forcefully across
senses.definition: to move quickly and with force over an area
senses.definitionCN: 快速有力地掠过一片区域
senses.example: A storm swept across the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 一场风暴席卷了海岸。
senses.why: The brush stroke becomes a wide movement.
senses.whyCN: 清扫的动作变成大范围的移动。

senses.title: To look over quickly
senses.definition: to move the eyes quickly over something
senses.definitionCN: 目光快速掠过某物
senses.example: Her eyes swept the room.
senses.exampleCN: 她扫视了一下房间。
senses.why: The wide motion becomes a quick look.
senses.whyCN: 大幅动作变成快速的一瞥。

intro.en: Sweep is an old Germanic word for brushing a surface clean.
intro.cn: sweep 是表示把表面扫净的古老日耳曼词。

items.en: Swepen meant to clean with a brush.
Sweep extended to moving across an area.
items.cn: sweep 扩展到掠过一片区域。

items.en: Sweep also describes a quick look.

note.en: Sweep is compared with look-alike words and with words for cleaning.

abstract.en: Wind and brooms both move in sweeps.

root: 来自古英语 swapan（扫），源于日耳曼语 swaipan。

sensesIntro.en: Sweep means to clean with a brush, to move across, or to glance over.
sensesIntro.cn: sweep 表示打扫、席卷或扫视。

core.en: One wide motion that clears or covers a space.
core.cn: 一个或清扫或覆盖空间的宽大动作。

branches.en: He sweeps the leaves every morning.
branches.cn: 他每天早上扫落叶。

branches.en: She swept the crumbs from the table.
